title: Password reset link expires immediately
body: The recovery email arrives but the reset link says expired on first click.

title: Recovery email URL already invalid
body: I cannot regain access to my account: the emailed recovery token has expired before I use it.

title: CSV export omits the final row
body: A table with 100 records downloads as 99 records. The last one is absent.

title: Last record missing from spreadsheet download
body: Exporting the full dataset to comma separated values drops the final entry.

title: App crashes when uploading a large avatar
body: Selecting a 20 MB profile photo closes the application. Small pictures work.

title: Big profile picture kills the process
body: The application exits when I pick a very large image for my user icon.

title: Keyboard focus gets trapped in modal
body: After opening the help dialog, Tab never reaches the close button. Escape does not close it.

title: Cannot dismiss help window without a mouse
body: Keyboard-only users are stuck inside the help popup and cannot reach its dismiss control.

title: Notification emails arrive twice
body: Every new comment triggers two identical email notifications.

title: Duplicate alerts in inbox for one reply
body: A single discussion response sends me the same email two times.

title: Search ignores accented characters
body: Searching cafe does not find café. Accents should be folded for matching.

title: Unaccented query misses diacritics
body: Typing resume cannot find résumé because search treats the accents differently.

title: Saved timezone resets after logout
body: Choose Asia/Colombo, sign out and back in. The preference reverts to UTC.

title: Region preference lost between sessions
body: My selected time zone is forgotten each time I log off and return.

title: PDF report has blank charts
body: The dashboard charts display correctly but the generated PDF leaves their areas empty.

title: Graphs disappear in printable report
body: Export as PDF produces white boxes where the visualizations should be.

title: Offline edits vanish on reconnect
body: Changes to notes made without connectivity are discarded when the network returns.

title: Notes written without internet are lost
body: After restoring a connection, my offline note changes disappear instead of syncing.

title: Sorting prices uses alphabetical order
body: The price list orders 10 before 2. Values appear to be compared as text.

title: Numbers sort like strings in cost column
body: Ascending cost puts 100 before 20 rather than comparing numeric amounts.

title: Password reset email never arrives
body: There is no recovery message in inbox or spam, even after an hour.

title: CSV export swaps column headings
body: All rows are present but the amount and date column names are exchanged.

title: Avatar thumbnail looks blurry
body: Uploading succeeds, but the small profile image has poor resolution.

title: Add sorting by date
body: Please add a date sort option; currently only price sorting is available.
